camel_example: aliyun adb BindDBResourceGroupWithUser --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName test --GroupUser accout --DBClusterId 'am-bp1ub9grke10000'
description_en: The BindDBResourceGroupWithUser operation attaches a database account to a resource group in a Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster
description_zh: 调用BindDBResourceGroupWithUser接口为数仓版集群的资源组绑定数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun adb bind-db-resource-group-with-user --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --group-name test --group-user accout --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindDBResourceGroupWithUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters in the destination region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The database account to attach. You can attach a standard account or a privileged account
parameters.help_zh: 需要绑定的数据库账号。既可以绑定数据库普通账号，也可以绑定数据库高权限账号
parameters.name: group_user

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一。大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token
